bio.p1: Full Stack Software Engineer focused on Generative AI, RAG architectures and Model Context Protocol (MCP). Currently at CI&T as a Systems Analyst, leading reverse engineering and AI-driven automation projects for large global enterprises.
bio.p2: Previously at Fractal and Solinski Corp, where I worked on legacy system modernization, performance optimization and DevOps. Studying Systems Analysis & Development at FIAP, with advanced English and experience in agile environments.

fullstack.title: Full Stack & AI
fullstack.desc: I work across the full stack — frontend to backend — with a growing focus on Generative AI, RAG pipelines and autonomous agents.

cleancode.title: Clean Code
cleancode.desc: Organized, scalable and maintainable code, with attention to best practices and performance.

impact.title: High Impact
impact.desc: Experience in demanding projects: load time reduced from 13s to 5s, production systems serving large global enterprises.

translation.Tecnologias e ferramentas que uso no dia: Technologies and tools I use daily

frontend.desc: I build modern, performant interfaces with React and Next.js. I work with TypeScript from the ground up, ensuring solid typing and reusable components.

backend.desc: I develop robust APIs and services with Node.js and Python. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, plus event-driven architectures.

ai.desc: My main speciality right now — I build solutions with LLMs, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Production experience with Azure OpenAI for large global clients.

devops.desc: Containerization, CI/CD and cloud environments on a daily basis.
